steps.text: Set up workbench: left=parts for current process, middle=work area with anti-static mat, right=finished storage. No phones, cups or keys on bench.
PPE: anti-static gloves for electronics; nitrile gloves for grease/threadlocker; hair tied, no jewelry, cuffs tight.
Assign IDs to ALL motors and encoder-calibrate (Damiao Motor Debugging Documentation) per the motor ID layout BEFORE assembly.
Battery check: any pack dropped >30 cm or hit must NOT be installed; label red, isolate 24 h.
Orient parts to standing pose; motor interface vertical; DM-J10010L label end faces down.
Position with 2x M4x12, fill remaining holes M4x8 diagonally, swap positioning screws for M4x8. Threadlocker.
Seat DM4340p in lower-leg holes; two serial ports, one top one bottom.
Flip; M3x8 socket head, position with M3x12 first then diagonal.
Radial spherical plain bearing; hand press; M4x8 flat head.
Ankle roll connector must fit tight in universal joint cross bearing; hand-press if loose.
Calf bearing lock.
Foot (20 cm), rubber foot pad.
Thrust needle roller + cage: install ONLY the middle bearing, NOT the two outer washers.
Secure.
Per left/right: remove matching M4x8, insert limit pin, drive M4x14.
DM-J10010L + hip clamp plate, motor interfaces same direction; M4x8 with M4x12 positioning; diagonal, then max torque, at least 2 cycles.
Second hip clamp plate: tap reverse side with hammer until sound is solid everywhere; M4x8 + M4x12 positioning.
Thrust needle roller: middle bearing only.
Universal connectors, DM-J10010L (align power hole with threaded hole), universal counter-reamed flange.
M3x8 to finish hip joint.
Thrust needle roller (middle only); M5x10. Result: lower body.
Hip joint mount + DM-J10010L, IMU on carrier board. Use manual wrench in deep recesses.
Place hip joint into hip section; M4x12, outermost first.
Deep groove ball bearing, waist support, battery bottom cover. ORIENTATION: bearing limit slot faces FRONT; battery-cover limit slot faces BACK.
Clamp plate, shoulder, side cross plate (M4x10). Leave ONE side cross plate off for battery install.
DM4340p interface vertically UP; arm 5; mirror other side.
DM4340p interface faces robot facing direction; arms 1-4.
Elbow motor interface DOWN, shoulder motor interface UP; diagonal M3x16.
Forearm upper/lower: M3x10 and M3x16.
Install battery, then the side cross plate from step 43 (M4x10).
Cable management plates, all M4x8 flat head; arm / hip joint / hip / groin / thigh / knee positions per figure.
Metal button switch, emergency stop (tighten; circuit board clipped on back), power charging port, metal handle (M6x10).
Slave IDs chain: R arm 0x13-0x17; L arm 0x0E-0x12; R leg 0x07-0x0C; L leg 0x01-0x06; waist 0x0D (to 0x07).
Harnesses: Leg01/02 25cm, Leg03 40cm, Leg04 30cm, Leg05 10cm (CAN lead orientation consistent), Body01 waist 0x0D-0x07, Arm01-04 20cm.
Battery: anti-vibration foam on bottom and four sides. High current: check gauge and polarity.
Solder main switch + e-stop; DO NOT get wire order wrong; follow PCB silkscreen; colour order varies per batch.
CAN0=0x01 (Body03 60cm), CAN1=0x0D (Body04 50cm), CAN2=0x0E and CAN3=0x13 (Body02 20cm). Manual 2026.06.16 fix: 0x0d, not 0x07.
RDKx5: usb-to-typec to USB-to-CAN port; typec-to-typec 5 V from power board. IMU and gamepad receiver USB direct to RDKx5.
Secure with harness clips; UV adhesive on CAN connectors.
Arm pins: M4x18 (cylindrical pin GB119).
Leg pins: M4x22. Not fully inserting is fine if joint rotation is constrained; rubber hammer to insert, needle-nose pliers to remove.
Waist: limit blocks on waist support + battery bottom cover; contact at about +/-120 degrees. Upper body rotates counterclockwise to the block, lower body stationary.
